settings.title: Confirmed
settings.text: We have your order and are picking it from the shelf.

settings.title: Shipped
settings.text: Handed to the carrier. Tracking link sent by email and SMS.

settings.title: Out for delivery
settings.text: With the rider. Keep your phone reachable for COD orders.

settings.title: Changed your mind
settings.text: Seven days from delivery to return, one free size exchange.

settings.heading: Track your order
settings.text: Every order ships with a tracking link by email and SMS. You can also look it up here.

settings.question: My tracking has not updated in two days.
settings.answer: Carrier scans can lag over weekends and holidays. If it has been more than three working days, write to us with your order number and we will chase it.

settings.question: Can I change the delivery address?
settings.answer: Only before the order ships. Reply to your confirmation email as soon as you can and we will try.

settings.question: I missed the delivery.
settings.answer: Carriers reattempt twice. After that the parcel returns to us and we refund automatically.
